Still, we did our best to support Worbital, and hoping to continue doing so in 2020. We’re also happy to welcome the lovers of cosmic chaos who joined us on PS4, Xbox One and Nintendo Switch! As we are heading into the new year (new decade really, wow!), we will continue working to get more players into Worbital and will be looking forward to any exciting new projects 2020s will bring.

From all of TJR, wherever in the world you are, whatever your reasons are to be jolly this season: Happy Holidays! And Happy 2020!

notes.title: Worbital Content Update #4 - New Weapons, Fixes and Free Steam Weekend!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33169128/55d9409864096760b463576e1ed13997ea183e33.png[/img]

Here comes the much[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/761910/announcements/detail/1597013990395804233] anticipated[/url] fourth Worbital content update! And boy, do we have some stuff for you.

First and foremost, we did our best to fix the most essential bugs and issues that have been reported over the last months. Network issues, weapon bugs, visuals, balance - we fixed a whole bunch. Hopefully, this will make matches a lot smoother for many players.

Second - and most exciting, we added new weapons! Each of the factions gets one: [b]Partycle Ball[/b] (Celestials), [b]Bouncer[/b] (Lucid) and [b]Waste Missile[/b] (Terrene).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33169128/b0a8be17180876af64609649c811d822d1adc575.gif[/img]

See the full changelog for today’s update enclosed at the end of this announcement.

[h1]Consoles & Free Steam Weekend[/h1]
As we’ve announced earlier, this Friday we are launching Worbital on PS4, Xbox One and Nintendo Switch. At launch, cross-platform multiplayer will be functional for PC and Switch players. We’re also continuing work to connect players from the other platforms as well. The more the merrier!

In order to add yet more action for the coming days, Worbital has been approved for a free weekend on Steam! This will undoubtedly bring about a swarm of new players, in addition to the console folk. Gather your friends for some planet-busting action, [b]starting Oct. 17th at 10:00am[/b], lasting [b]until Oct. 20th 1:00pm (PT)[/b].

That’s about it. What do you think of the new weapons? Let us know in the comments, on [url=https://twitter.com/worbitalgame]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/worbitalgame/]Facebook[/url] or on our official [url=https://discord.gg/teamjollyroger]Discord server[/url].

Update #3, here we go! Let’s get busy.

We noted comments about the campaign being too difficult and we took them seriously. It is now even more difficult!

Okay, now stay with us! The main campaign has been made significantly easier since the launch. However, for those players who like a special challenge, we are now adding a special, [b]Extreme Campaign[/b] mode—go nuts! It contains all the same missions, except more difficult and with new endings and rewards.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33169128/46c130287a2df9eee0c2553dfa87899d0648adf7.png[/img]

For those of you who enjoy playing with a gamepad: this other new feature will rock your world. We added controller vibration! Now every shot, hit or explosion will bring a real, tactile feel. If you see a barrage coming your way—make sure you’re buckled in.

Last but not least, we are expanding our intercultural reach. Worbital is now available in German language. Willkommen!

[list]
[*][b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Extreme Campaign!
[list]
[*]A more difficult version of the campaign, unlocked for each faction after you finish their timeline. Includes new cosmetic rewards and ending images.
[/list]

[*]Controller Vibration
[/list]

[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that may have caused the game to freeze after being paused
[*]Starting an AI only match from the Alliance queue now properly starts a team match with 3 AIs
[*]Fire/Ice moons are now assigned with the correct ratio in Fire & Ice
[*]Ice solar flares caused by the Solaronite Gun now properly have their damage slightly reduced compared to their fire counterparts
[*]AI is now better at defending against asteroids
[*]Removed “Replace” button when highlighting empty planet sectors
[*]Minor bug fixes
[*]Minor text fixes

[*][b]Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*]Added Vacuum Bomb to player loadout in Lucid Mission 03, for added asteroid fun
[*]Changed the priorities of fund consumption in situations where you’re low and multiple structures are under construction. Instead of funds being distributed evenly, the first chosen structure is prioritised, making it less likely to accidentally slow down progress too much.
[/list]
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33169128/8937aa991a0d0c420346c8bd0337c203736007cc.jpg[/img]

Previously, you could navigate the solar system either with the default WASD or the arrow keys. Now it’s possible to rebind any keys in any way you like. This should make Worbital more accessible for different kinds of players, for example, left-handed players.

notes.title: Worbital: Online Demo Is Out!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33169128/046e10169bd31867103863c2db556f63f13b56cc.png[/img]

It’s almost a week since Worbital launched and, after some thinking, we decided to do a demo.
We now have a free online demo available on Steam, to help get more new players into the Worbital groove and to get more people into the online queues!

 The demo includes the tutorial and online quickplay matches with [b]default loadouts only[/b]. This means that demo players get to take part in online matches along with [b]all the other players[/b]. The big difference is that demo-players get only a very limited selection of weapons. We hope that this prompts more people to go for the full Worbital experience. Hopefully,  this will also bring a surge of new players to the quickplay queues.

If you’ve been considering buying Worbital, but still unsure—this is your perfect opportunity to make up your mind. The demo should give you a good picture of just the kind of fun Worbital offers. It’s free, so why not take it for a spin?

If you’ve already played Worbital, and would like to recommend it to some friends—please, direct them to the demo!

We’ve also released a patch to the full Worbital, containing some fixes. See the full [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/761910/discussions/0/1777135944135367920/]changelog on our Steam forum[/url].

Lastly, if you’ve played Worbital, [b]consider leaving us a review on Steam[/b].

Enjoy Worbital!

notes.title: Happy Holidays!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33169128/03d3ca3792024d891fe79d04c351a0edf3793a45.png[/img]
The year is coming to an end, and what a year it’s been! Before it’s over, here’s a quick summary of Worbital’s 2018.

[h1]Early 2018 [/h1]

We’ve been sharing our development progress since about October 2017 (if you’re interested, see our [url=https://worbital.tumblr.com/post/168751284681/status-update-20122017-wrapping-up-2017]2017 wrap-up post[/url] from a year ago), but 2018 was truly the year Worbital broke out into the world. By March, the alpha version was complete with all the key features of the game functional. After that, we focused on expanding the weapons’ arsenal and developing multiplayer modes. Some wild days were waiting ahead...

[h1]Public Beta[/h1]

By mid-summer, Worbital was ready for a public debut. We launched the public beta in July, and that’s when the magic began. From the very first days, the amount of people wanting to try the game exceeded our most optimistic expectations and, before we knew it, there was a real community building around Worbital. A big difference from our previous game releases was getting to speak to all of you directly through Discord (which, to be honest, sometimes was even too much fun for work days—still totally worth it). Discord also helped arrange community online matches during our Devs Play-events, where we often had our butts handed to us. In the process of it all, you gave us invaluable feedback that helped take Worbital to a whole new level. With some breaks in-between, Worbital beta lasted all the way until the end of October. Some 8,000 beta keys have been given out!

[h1]Post Beta 2 [/h1]

For the past month and a half, we’ve been gearing up for the full launch in early 2019—polishing the game, as well as adding some new features. While we’re at it, we hope that all of our beta-testers are still with us and looking forward to the launch as much as we do. Be prepared for some major news in January! It might even involve something about a new beta run...

Until then, all of us at TJR want to wish you happy holidays. Whether you’re with your family, loved ones or by your awesome self—may this holiday season be filled with joy and peace. 

Of course, we couldn’t let you go without a little present! Here’s a teaser for one of the newer Worbital weapons:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33169128/1846c0be74dfe710e17c34658bf13d786e897995.gif[/img]

If you’d like to support Worbital before its full launch, do follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/worbitalgame]Twitter [/url]or [url=https://www.facebook.com/worbitalgame/]Facebook[/url]. You can also[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/761910/Worbital/] wishlist the game on Steam[/url]. 

Blast you later!

notes.title: Worbital Status Update - Chugging Along
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33169128/72a8f95c0636e87d378f0c4635676874c068715a.png[/img]
Hey, Worbitalists! It’s been about three weeks since Worbital beta 2 closed and since [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/761910/announcements/detail/1701692330736243761]we announced the delay[/url] of the game’s full release. What have we been up to so far and how is Worbital doing? Let’s take a look together.

First things first: check out our new trailer above. This should be a worthy replacement for the currently outdated trailer on our Steam page and website. The new trailer was inspired by the awesome feedback we got from you during the beta run. Some of you might spot themselves in it…
https://youtu.be/_MjGaEdBtKs
Now, to the serious business. There are several things we’ve been focusing on over the past weeks. Here are some of the things we’ve been working on:
[*][b]Network Functionality Improved[/b] 
[/list]
We’ve fixed the bug that caused matches to be stuck in loading screen. Good to finally have that one out of the way. 
[*][b]Improving AI[/b] 
[/list]
The AI is learning day by day and becoming more fun to play with. It is now better at defending against super weapons, and it’s learned to steer itself when derailed. Soon it’ll outsmart all of us, just you wait.
[*][b]Updated UI/UXI[/b] 
[/list]
Some UI tweaks have been done across the board, making the playing experience more smooth. We’ve made some changes to the Main Menu, the Loadout menu and gameplay UI, making them overall more intuitive. 
[*][b]Unlocking Weapons, Character and Planet CustomizationI[/b] 
[/list]
We’ve been working on customization for the looks of advisor characters and player planets. Over the last weeks we’ve expanded the variety of outfits and planet skins. Space fashion show coming up?

Customization items and many of the weapons will be unlockable with the new unlock system. Basically, you earn points after every match and you can use those points to unlock extra weapons for your Battle Kit and other items.
[*][b]More Weapons[/b] 
[/list]
Of course, we’ve added MORE WEAPONS. Can there ever be enough? The new weapons include Cryogenesis, Dragon Missile, Flamethrower, Minefield, Burst Missiles and many others.

See some of those newest weapons demonstrated in the GIFs below.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33169128/690aa2656708b9f63ca1c0241daaa509902a0e2d.gif[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33169128/214684e9df4a9649550c7ee68947107244856430.gif[/img]
[*][b]Bug Fixing, Testing and Polish[/b] 
[/list]
Above everything else, for the past weeks we’ve been occupied with bug fixing, polishing and testing the game. Polish is essential now that we are adding new features and weapons, to make sure they all work together well.

Polish and test-test-test. You might’ve spotted “Playing Worbital”-tag on some of the devs’ profiles. No need to feel jealous, we’re only testing the new stuff for you! And having tons of fun while doing it…
[*][b]New Features[/b] 
[/list]
Because our release had been delayed, parts of the team got time to work on a couple of completely new features which weren’t included in the original release plan. We don’t want to give away much yet, but let’s just say that there’s more than one star in the Worbital universe…

In other news: last week, some of us have been showcasing Worbital to gamedev peers from all over the world at the [url=https://www.migs18.com/en/home/]Montreal International Game Summit[/url] in Canada. That was probably the last public event we attended with Worbital this year, not that there’s much left of this year anymore.

These are all the news so far. Thank you for continuing to support Worbital during this break. We’ll be back with more news before the holidays. Until then, keep on worbing.

Blast you later!

notes.title: Worbital Delayed Until Early 2019
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33169128/ca674d104cf97225d28f9cec62322ad7fdc26ede.jpg[/img]

[i]“A delayed game is eventually good, a bad game is bad forever.” - Shigeru Miyamoto[/i]

Thank you so much for participating in Worbital Beta 2! Unfortunately, issues came up during the Beta 2 run that forced a difficult choice upon us—as a result, we have decided to postpone the launch of Worbital from its predicted launch date of late 2018 to early 2019.

While we hadn’t formally announced a release date, the implication had been that it was just around the corner, which it was, but is no longer. We sincerely apologize for the disappointment, but you can be absolutely sure, Worbital will be much better for it.

The rescheduling has given us some new challenges, but primarily, new opportunities. The extra time will allow parts of the team to focus on new features and weapons, in addition to the planned necessary fixes and polish. You can consider these new features as a big bonus to reward you for your patience.

We’ll be hanging around the [url=https://discord.gg/kYYcrQu]Team Jolly Roger Discord[/url] as always, chatting and answering questions. However, we’ll do fewer teasers than before, as constant reminders certainly wouldn’t make the wait any easier. A status update every few weeks should keep you nicely up to speed. So, do stick around and let’s make this delay more bearable for us all.

Once again, sorry for making you wait. We wouldn’t do this if we weren’t absolutely sure that it will be worth it.

notes.title: Worbital Beta Update #7 - Emotes, Build Limits & More

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33169128/1250a7eb142485079534b6496b8924409856c470.jpg[/img]

Let’s go, beta update #7! This time we attempt to make things more social in Worbital and also to limit weapon spamming. Let us take a look.

Last week we added AI bots, so you could avoid playing with humans. But now it’s time to get more social. Worbital now has emotes! Emotes are scripted messages you can send to your playmates through your advisor character. You might not be able to share elaborate strategy plans, but you can have fun taunting. Or, you can apologize to your teammate for shooting them. This is a neat way for quick communication between players—simple enough to get a basic message across, but not so distracting as to pull you out of the heat of the game. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33169128/8b97bedd5852577dd71caec85191a15c180e2df7.png[/img]

Autocannon, Railgun, Nuclear Missile… This understandably can be frustrating to other players, but it’s been a legit strategy until now. Starting with this update, we have a structure limit imposed. It allows only a certain number of one weapon to be built at the same time. For instance, you can’t have more than 3 Lasers on your planet at once. Or more than 1 nuke… After testing this internally, we saw that the limit prompted more creative strategies and also made matches more dynamic.

In this week’s beta update, we are adding several new weapons. Some of those affect gravity of objects around them, while others ignore gravity completely…

The main stars of this update are Magnet Gun and Gun Magnet. Both weapons shoot magnetic projectiles, which can mess with enemy projectiles when activated. Magnet Gun attracts projectiles, as expected. Gun Magnet, with its reversed polarity, repels projectiles.

As we all know, plasma isn't affected by gravity and moves very slowly, so hitting your enemy with it is tricky, but worth it. notes.title: Worbital Public Beta is Open Now, Join on Discord!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33169128/c5e6e24df3848e95398c9350ed8a1f698151fdee.jpg[/img]

Let the cosmic mayhem begin! We are rolling out the Worbital public beta and we invite you to join.

With the launch of the complete game still some time ahead, we thought it would be great to take Worbital out for a test-drive. Starting today, we make a limited version of the game available through Steam. You can sign up by joining our Discord server and requesting a key. Our moderators will get it to you by private message as soon as possible. Join the server with this invite: https://discord.gg/kYYcrQu.
Note: though we have a generous supply of keys to offer, their number is limited.

Watch our Beta trailer: https://youtu.be/z9AAamrnq1c 

The public beta version of Worbital is different from the one that will be available for purchase at release, as Worbital is still work in progress. Currently it has limited weapon loadout and online multiplayer mode only. Gradually we will introduce more features into the game through regular updates. This will help keep the testing more focused on specific features at certain times. During the beta run, you can expect to see AI and Local Multiplayer modes, as well as additional weapons and a few other things. The beta will become unavailable shortly prior to the final release. After that, Worbital will only be available through purchase. More additions will come to the final game, let them remain a surprise for now.

As the testing goes on, we’ll ask you to fill in a few tester surveys for us, so we can get as much as possible useful info to improve the game. The survey forms will be shared on Discord. In addition to that, every now and then we’ll be asking you more direct questions on the #testing chat.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33169128/5bb3d908c38e09ae02b539b634e7d19741b3f410.jpg[/img]  

Our main focus for the public beta and especially its first weeks is testing the online network. That’s why we would like to come and play online with you. This week, Thursday July 12th, join us for a match or two and just to chat about stuff. We’ll be playing starting 5pm EEST/ 10am EDT. See you there!

Whether you’re joining the beta or saving it all till the final launch,consider adding Worbital to your Steam wishlist.

[b]TL;DR:[/b]

Worbital beta is open. To apply:

1. Join our official Discord server with this invite: https://discord.gg/kYYcrQu
2. Request a beta key by posting to Worbital #request-beta-key chat (mods will send the key to you as direct message)
3. Activate the received product key on Steam

Happy blasting!
